name: Exp_Delta_MFI
summary: This EA trades based on the Delta MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, which combines volume analysis with price range movements to identify momentum shifts. It enters positions when the delta between current and previous MFI values signals strengthening or weakening market facilitation, typically used to catch trending moves driven by volume participation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta MFI（市场促进指数）指标进行交易，通过结合成交量分析与价格范围变动来识别动量转换。当当前MFI值与前期MFI值的差值发出市场促进加强或减弱的信号时开仓，通常用于捕捉由成交量参与推动的趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是Delta MFI指标，即市场促进指数的变化量，用于衡量市场参与度和动量的变化。入场条件基于MFI差值的正负变化：当Delta MFI为正且成交量增加时，视为多头信号入场做多；当Delta MFI为负且成交量增加时，视为空头信号入场做空。出场条件可能基于反向的Delta MFI信号或固定的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA使用止损来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险控制机制取决于参数设置。整体策略属于动量类策略，依赖成交量确认价格运动的有效性，适合趋势明显且成交量活跃的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA revolves around the Delta MFI indicator, which measures changes in the Market Facilitation Index to gauge shifts in market participation and momentum. Entry conditions are based on the sign and magnitude of the MFI delta: a positive Delta MFI accompanied by increasing volume serves as a bullish signal for long entries, while a negative Delta MFI with rising volume signals bearish conditions for short entries. Exit conditions likely rely on opposing Delta MFI signals or predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels to manage trade closure. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculations based on account equity and risk parameters. Money management incorporates stop-loss orders to limit per-trade risk exposure, though the effectiveness depends heavily on parameter configuration. The overall approach is a momentum-based strategy that relies on volume confirmation to validate price movements, making it most suitable for trending markets with active volume participation.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing different EA's orders

pros: 结合成交量与价格范围分析，策略逻辑有统计学依据，比单纯价格指标更可靠
Delta MFI能提前感知市场参与度变化，有助于捕捉趋势早期阶段
策略概念清晰，参数相对简单，便于理解和优化
pros_en: Combines volume and price range analysis providing statistically grounded logic that is more reliable than price-only indicators
Delta MFI can detect shifts in market participation early, helping capture the early stages of trends
Clear strategy concept with relatively simple parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
cons: 在低成交量或震荡市中容易产生虚假信号，导致频繁亏损
默认止损止盈可能为零，缺乏有效的风险控制机制
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
未考虑点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能不利
cons_en: Prone to false signals in low-volume or ranging markets, leading to frequent losses
Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero, lacking effective risk control mechanisms
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No spread filter considered, which can be detrimental on instruments with wide spreads
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓；增加点差过滤，防止在高点差环境下交易
增加成交量阈值过滤和自适应止损机制，根据市场波动率动态调整止损止盈水平
improvements_en: Add new bar check to prevent repeated entries on the same bar; add spread filter to avoid trading in high-spread conditions
Add volume threshold filtering and adaptive stop-loss mechanism that dynamically adjusts stop-loss and take-profit based on market volatility

risk_points: 默认止损可能为零，存在无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查，可能在短时间内重复开仓导致过度持仓
在震荡行情中可能产生连续虚假信号造成连亏
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss may be zero, posing unlimited loss risk
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position opening in a short time leading to overexposure
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets may result in a string of losses
